entities.summary: Mauritania is a sovereign nation in West Africa, Africa. Its capital is Nouakchott. Official languages include Arabic. Government: Unitary semi-presidential Islamic republic. Population: approximately 5.0 million. Area: 1,030,700 km². Comprehensive index for Mauritania covering Berber-Arab nomadic heritage, Ghana Empire overlap, trans-Saharan trade, Almoravid movement, French colonisation, slavery abolition (last country 1981/2007 criminalisation), military coups, and Sahel security.
